title: Minimizing Material Waste in Additive Manufacturing through Online Reel Assignment
summary: We study a variant of the online bin packing problem that arises in filament-based 3D printing systems operating in make-to-order settings, where only a limited number of filament reels of finite capacity can be handled at once. Components are assigned to reels upon arrival and insufficient reels are discarded to be replaced with new ones, resulting in material waste.
